title: 100 best creams for medicinal use
intro: Creams are topical preparations made by combining herbal extracts with a base of oil, water, or both, to create a smooth, spreadable texture. In herbalism, creams are used to deliver medicinal properties directly to the skin, often for treating conditions like eczema, psoriasis, or muscle aches. They can be infused with herbs such as calendula, chamomile, or eucalyptus to enhance their therapeutic effects. The base allows for controlled absorption of the active herbal components. Creams are a versatile and effective method for applying herbal remedies in a convenient and targeted manner.
